summary: AST INVEST AS (org. no. 927 430 789) is a private limited company (AS) based in Asker, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2021-07-16. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 00.000 (Uoppgitt); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was NOK 10 203. Board chair: Atle Homdrom Sten. Also: LEI 98450077B5CE513F0890.
